To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have identified a new antigenic specificity, provisionally named LD-MN2, that is associated with HLA-Dw12 and HLA-DRw12.

we have defined a new DR2 associated HLA specific antigenic cluster, LD-MN2, that we have shown to be interrelated with two previously defined specificities, LD-5a and tb24, that we have demonstrated that these three specificities are not shared by the DR2 associated Dw2 and Dw2 specificities, and that these studies emphasize the necessity for studying new specificities by both PLT reagents and HTC reagents, and testing different ethnic groups.

we have defined a new DR2 associated HLA-DR specificity, LD-MN2, which is distinct from the Dw2 and Dw 12 specificities, and that LD-MN2 and LD-5 share some determinants not shared with Dw2 and Dw-12.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification and characterization of HLA-D specificities associated with DR2, and their relationship to the DR2 associated specificities Dw2, Dw12, LD-5a and tb24.
the study of HLA-Dw and HLA-DR antigens in North American Caucasians.
defining new DR2 associated HLA specificities, and with identifying the relationships of these specificities with other DR2 associated specificities.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
LD-MN2, LD-5a (BAS, REM), and tb24 (FJO) are three different antigenic clusters associated with DR2.
LD-5a and MN2 are distinct specificities, though sharing some determinants.
the LD-5A, MN2, and TB24 specificities are all related to the DR2 specificity, though they are not identical.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
LD-MN2 is a new DR2 associated cluster which shares some determinants with LD-5a and tb24, but differs in its association with HLA-Dw specificities.
DR2+ Dw2 and Dw 12 cells have some antigenic determinants in common with DR2+ Dw MN2 cells but differ by other stimulatory epitopes.
the LD-MN cluster is a DR2 associated cluster which is distinct from Dw2 and from the Dw12 specificity, and which is closely related to, but distinct from, the LD-5 specificity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the LD typing methodology is a powerful and useful tool in the study of HLA class II molecules.
the LD-MN-2 specificity, which we defined by PLT studies, is closely linked to the LD-5A specificity, which was defined by HTC studies.
the DR2+ Dw2 and Dw 12+ cells are not the only cells that can be typed as DR2+.
